changes.text: In 2022, GreenPower entered into a lease purchase agreement with the state of West Virginia to establish manufacturing operations for all-electric school buses.
changes.evidence: GreenPower entered into a lease purchase agreement with the state for an 80,000 square foot facility on six acres of land to manufacture all-electric school buses for the US market.

changes.text: In 2022, GreenPower acquired all assets of Lion Truck Body Inc., a truck body manufacturer located in Torrance, CA.
changes.evidence: On July 7, 2022, GreenPower entered into an asset purchase agreement with Lion Truck Body Inc., a truck body manufacturer located in Torrance, CA, under which Greenpower purchased all of the assets of the business through its wholly owned subsidiary, Lion Truck Body Incorporated.
